authorization: Root explicitly approved the single wording-only 0.5B alternative after complete 14B failure; replaces the optional direct-lookup branch, does not add to the 64-request feasibility ceiling.
archive_binding: A separate freeze receipt must bind the supplied fixed archive, exact recipe and instruction text before execution.

native_feasibility.baseline: Original RECORD-LANGUAGE v1 FULL context, unchanged.
native_feasibility.candidate: Explicit grammar instructions with fixed unrelated example; FULL original records retained. No dependency slicing, answer substitution or task/seed change.

advance_rule: Advance only if the clarified candidate has exactly 8/8 correct in BOTH complete repetitions under unchanged exact scoring, raw evidence reconciles, no capped completion passes, and observed full-wall cost allows the finite remaining main campaign within the existing 180-minute native budget and original allocation deadline. The baseline remains in every denominator and all paired classes. This is solely development diagnosis; a failing baseline cannot become an eligible efficiency comparison.
stop_rule: If clarification fails, no further prompt, task or seed search under this investigation. Retain all results and leave trained-controller and confirmation gates incomplete. No automatic rerun or replacement of failed attempts.

remaining_proposed_main_if_feasible.scope: Only a proposed main matrix. Separate exact training protocol and confirmation freeze required; mixed family minimum subgroup coverage must be disclosed.

interpretation: No model training or novelty claim. The same records/expected answers isolate instruction wording causally within one fixed model. A pass would only support feasibility of later explicit-language mixed tasks.
